files.revenue.sql:
SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
       SUM(o.total_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 5;
